section_summary.extract_value: This section details the materials used in a study, focusing on two primary measures. The first is J. C. Kaufman's (2012) K-DOCS, a 50-item self-report measure assessing domain-specific creativity across five domains: Everyday, Scholarly, Performance, Science, and Art. The second is Goldberg's (1999; Goldberg et al., 2006) 100-item International Personality Item Pool (IPIP), which measures the Big Five personality factors. No specific study numbers or multiple sample subsets are mentioned.
